titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
The Internet has become an essential part of our daily lives. Thanks to it, students can find information for their studies in seconds, and people can work, shop and communicate from home. During the last few years, online learning has helped millions of students continue their education, even when they could not go to school. However, the Internet also has some dangers. Some young people spend too many hours online and become addicted. Others share private information with strangers or believe false news. Therefore, we should use the Internet wisely: it is a wonderful tool, but only if we control it instead of letting it control us.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Give two advantages of the Internet mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
2) How did online learning help students?   (1,5 marks)
3) Give two dangers of the Internet mentioned in the text.   (2,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the present perfect: The Internet (become) ______ essential.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "too much / too many": Some young people spend ______ hours online.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (however / therefore): It is a wonderful tool; ______, we should use it wisely.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give an adverb from the adjective "wise" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Is the Internet more useful or more dangerous for young people?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with advantages and disadvantages. Use linkers.
